description: Discover this stunning, brand-new, air-conditioned apartment—perfect for a comfortable stay in the heart of Paris—combining modern design, high-quality amenities, and a welcoming atmosphere. Enjoy a prime location close to shops, restaurants, and public transport, making it easy to explore the capital's finest sights. It is the perfect base for a getaway with a partner, family, or friendsThe spaceWelcome to our air-conditioned 96 m² apartment, located on the first floor (please note there is no elevator access to this floor). It is laid out as follows for your comfort:- 1 spacious living room with a double sofa bed, TV, and Wi-Fi- 1 fully equipped open-plan kitchen (refrigerator, freezer, Nespresso coffee machine, toaster, kettle, washer-dryer, dishwasher, microwave, oven, and stovetop)- 1 dining area for 8 people- 1 double bedroom with a queen-size bed and en-suite bathroom (sink, shower, and toilet)- 2 double bedrooms with queen-size beds- 1 bathroom with shower, sink, and toilet- 1 separate toiletThe apartment comprises 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 3 toilets.Bed linen and towels are provided based on the number of guests.Cleaning is carried out by professional staff.Guest accesstravellers have access to the entire flatOther things to noteADDITIONAL Services (optional)• Baby bed: Price - 60€• Late arrivalAfter 7.00 pm : 30€After 10.00 pm : 50€This booking is protected with coverage for lost baggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Swift Travel Cover with claim up to 750 Euros (T&C Applies). Full details available at booking.
